selected_families.container: Linux amd64 native manager and existing bundled engines
selected_families.deployment: Mage HX 370; existing llama.cpp ROCm/Vulkan and CPU speech profiles

required_acceptance.native: All identity and backend capability contracts pass on each selected core build platform; existing Linux process/shared-artifact contracts pass in image build
required_acceptance.api: All 39 isolated API cases pass, including four prefixes, unknowns, disabled policy, authentication, legacy records, graph rejection, Omni and alias rejection
required_acceptance.ui: All 73 fixture workflows and 19 logic tests pass; inspect capability Info at 1440px and 390px; no body overflow or unexpected writes
required_acceptance.image: Existing runtime packaging, actual CPU cache, preparation, runtime switch, tuning, SDK and two live browser workflows pass
required_acceptance.recovery: Independent whole-volume snapshot with sole writer stopped; candidate and restored v0.8.6 preserve model inventory, policies, selected profiles and native configuration hashes; four Hot services recover; neutral Qwen/Ornith arithmetic and generated-speech transcription pass
required_acceptance.deployment: Exact approved image/source recorded; all 50 downloads, 46 saved option sets, seven prior loaded models, four Hot models, volume/network/device/resource identities preserved; actual HA-container chat and Wyoming discovery plus Pi discovery pass
required_acceptance.failure: A required failure blocks production promotion. Keep the previous image and consistent backup. Restore the previous complete state on migration failure. No unsupported target becomes qualified by compilation.

state_change.behavior: New prompt snapshots use normalized principal/credential epoch. Legacy snapshot files and manifests remain retained, without reassignment. First use can rebuild cold.
state_change.interrupted_migration: No multi-file migration introduced; existing legacy interrupted-job recovery and retained-record fixtures are mandatory.
state_change.backup: Entire juiced_data volume, plus retained external read-only weight volumes and previous image. Secret values stay outside receipts.

not_delivered: P1 resource reservations or latency protection
New inference engines or hardware acceleration paths
Model/runtime revision promotion or automatic upgrades
New protocol or cross-protocol persistent cache qualification
Portable native installer or unseen hardware qualification
Performance improvement or model quality ranking
